findings.passage: So I'm going to call on the General Assembly to pass Real ID this session,
findings.note: Quoted by WSB-TV. He asks the legislature to require a Real ID to vote.

findings.passage: Requiring Real ID to vote adds an extra layer of protection.
findings.note: Quoted by WUGA. Gives his reason for a Real ID requirement to vote.

findings.passage: The General Assembly needs to pass this legislation this session to safeguard our elections.
findings.note: Quoted by Atlanta News First on his Real ID to vote request.

findings.passage: The left said that photo ID for in-person voting would suppress votes. It didn't.
findings.note: Quoted by WTOC in his statement defending SB 202. He says photo ID for in-person voting did not suppress votes.

findings.passage: With open borders, citizenship verification for voter registration is more important than ever,
findings.note: Quoted by WRDW when he asked the General Assembly for a constitutional amendment limiting voting to citizens.

findings.passage: the real issue that we’re facing right now is noncitizen voting.
findings.note: Quoted by Fox 5 Atlanta (published date; exact date of remark not given).

findings.passage: Thanks to the Georgia Election Integrity Act, our state remains the best, most secure state for voting.
findings.note: Quoted by WRDW after a court ruling on parts of SB 202. General praise of the law; no ID detail in the article.
